subject: How to update the prosterior sequentially?

messages.author: 40b63348dbcb447d
messages.subject: How to update the prosterior sequentially?
parts:
Hi,

suppose the samples I have are series of features (for example, paths in a 2D plane). Denote the features in the series i as {x_{k,i}}_{k=1}^{n_i}. Now I want to learn a global parameter \theta, and a series-specific parameter \theta_i, through a likelihood P(x_{k+1,i} | \theta,\theta_i,x_{k,i}) (a Gaussian process, for example). The posterior I want to sample from is P(\theta_i | series_i = {x_{k,i}}_{k=1}^{n_i}, \theta) and P(\theta | all series). Intuitively, I want to update the posterior of \theta_i sequentially as the series_i goes on. Is it possible to do this in Stan? Thank you.

Best,
Ziyuan

not”.
